history.repeating_the_same_answer_does_n: Repeating the same answer does not add effective errors. Empty or duplicate answers do not create extra review debt.
history.creating_practice_tests_or_revie: Creating practice, tests, or review sessions immediately shows a busy state. Repeated clicks or network retries reuse the original session rather than selecting again.
history.after_solving_with_repeated_atte: After solving with repeated attempts or help, choose Similar questions / Check. The generator uses the original question, attempts, help, and tags to create 1-5 checks with the same core skill, a different surface, and no lower difficulty. Each is selected from 3 reviewed candidates. They are appended without switching until you choose Start similar questions.
history.mastery_is_computed_per_learner_: Mastery is computed per learner, tag, and star level using first/final correctness, effective errors, help level, answer reveals, time since practice, checks, sample size, and question quality.
history.mastery_returns_score_mastery_le: Mastery returns score, mastery_level, confidence, next_review_at, and reason_codes. This is an explainable rule-based model, not an unconstrained AI judgment.
history.due_review_and_answer_reveal_rev: Due review and answer-reveal review cards create separate review_practice sessions without changing original test or set scores.
history.weak_tag_checks_create_regular_p: Weak-tag checks create regular practice for the target tags and difficulty to assess mastery.
history.continue_unfinished_resumes_the_: Continue unfinished resumes the matching session. If no review is due, the fallback task is 5 balanced questions.
history.sets_multiple_blanks_text_expres: Sets, multiple blanks, text, expressions, open responses, and non-unique numerical answers automatically trigger AI answer review.
history.viewing_a_full_solution_creates_: Viewing a full solution creates review debt. Later correctness on this question no longer counts as independent mastery.
history.history_groups_practice_tests_ge: History groups practice, tests, generated-set practice, and reviews by date and session.
history.retrying_a_group_weak_questions_: Retrying a group, weak questions, or selected questions creates a new review_practice session. Original test, set, and history results are unchanged.
history.history_session_creation_prevent: History session creation prevents duplicate clicks; replaying the same request returns the original review session.
history.review_sessions_use_regular_prac: Review sessions use regular-practice rules, including AI review, concerns, hints, answer reveal, and explanations. Revealing an answer in an earlier session does not lock the new session.
history.for_suspected_serious_quality_is: For suspected serious quality issues, select quarantine when creating a draft. The question leaves the practice/test pool and enters the review queue.
history.impact_statistics_show_affected_: Impact statistics show affected learners, sessions, submissions, wrong records, reveals, and open review items, with recent sessions and recalculation policies for reports, history, mastery, and exports.
history.after_repairing_an_answer_specif: After repairing an answer specification, preview regrading first. Applying updates submission judgments, error flags, and version pointers, and logs submission_regraded events. Reports and history recalculate on refresh; old exports must be exported again.
history.bank_exports_exclude_ordinary_an: Bank exports exclude ordinary answer history, sessions, reports, AI logs, and API keys. Export bank and history packages separately when upgrading or moving computers.
history.real_calls_use_up_to_5_non_ai_po: Real calls use up to 5 non-AI positive examples and up to 3 same-star, similar-tag AI anti-duplicate examples by default. Advanced settings adjust these counts.
history.sets_also_reuse_similar_unattemp: Sets also reuse similar unattempted AI questions first. Progress distinguishes reused, newly generated, running, rejected, and failed items.
history.similarity_control_combines_exam: Similarity control combines example retrieval, design strategies, normalized content, semantic signatures, question families, and set review rather than relying only on tags.
history.set_review_returns_a_similarity_: Set review returns a similarity matrix, diversity scores, and slots requiring regeneration. High-risk candidates do not enter practice directly.
history.strict_tests_can_exclude_answere: Strict tests can exclude answered and recently exposed questions to reduce repeated testing of similar items.
history.core_metrics_include_questions_s: Core metrics include questions, submissions, first/final accuracy, help usage, answer-reveal review debt, and question incidents.
history.setting_both_dates_enables_compa: Setting both dates enables comparison with the preceding equal-length window. Changes in volume, accuracy, hints, and review debt do not establish causality.
history.start_any_next_step_review_task_: Start any next-step review task directly. It creates a separate session using the task's tags, stars, and count, prioritizing unattempted questions.
history.clearing_history_also_clears_rep: Clearing history also clears reports. Export history before upgrading instead of clearing it.
history.validate_history_performs_a_full: Validate history performs a full dry run and counts without database writes.
history.history_import_maps_sources_by_f: History import maps sources by filename and hash rather than machine-specific source_file_id. Same-name sources with different hashes remain separate.
history.before_upgrading_or_copying_expo: Before upgrading or copying, export bank and history packages. On the new version, import the bank package or bundled JSON first, then history.
history.strict_test_ai_review_stores_onl: Strict-test AI review stores only judgments and redacted results, with no answers, steps, missing items, or hints. Failed concern requests do not overwrite grading or submissions.
history.complex_answers_are_automaticall: Complex answers are automatically reviewed for equivalence. Regular practice also supports manual AI review with safe feedback.

history.click_question_numbers_to_add_th: Click question numbers to add them to a cross-group basket. Mix practice, generated sets, tests, reviews, and prior similar-question batches. Approved questions enter the bank, history, practice, and reports.

history.packages_include_questions_versi: Packages include questions, versions, answer specifications, tags, and review queues; not answer history, AI logs, or API keys. Retire specific questions from Question bank.
history.history_groups_and_question_perf: History groups and question-performance colors are calculated from submissions and answer events. Refresh History after regrading to see updated results.
history.the_mastery_profile_is_recalcula: The mastery profile is recalculated from current submissions. Changes to correctness or effective errors affect weak areas and today's tasks.
history.counts_answer_reveal_debt_create: Counts answer_reveal_debt_created events that schedule review after viewing an answer.
history.with_small_samples_one_accuracy_: With small samples, one accuracy result does not establish stable mastery.
